milestones.title: Sprint 0 · Foundations
milestones.description: Repo, board, CI and API contract agreed; partner can run the project locally.

milestones.title: v0.1 · Walking skeleton
milestones.description: KPIs flow end-to-end: agent → gRPC → collector, all in Docker.

milestones.description: Scaled collectors, Prometheus + Grafana dashboard, CI smoke test.

milestones.title: v0.3 · Resilience & intelligence

issues.title: Configure Project board views and Sprint iteration field
issues.body:
Finish the parts of the Project board that the API cannot create.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Iteration field `Sprint` with 1-week iterations starting Mon 9 Nov (plus Sprint 0)
- [ ] Board view grouped by Status, filtered to the current sprint
- [ ] Table view 'Backlog' sorted by Priority
- [ ] Roadmap view by Sprint
- [ ] Built-in workflows on: item added → Todo, PR merged → Done, item closed → Done, auto-add issues from this repo
- [ ] Insights chart: burn-up by Estimate for the current Sprint

issues.title: Spike: research 5G RAN KPIs and choose the ones we simulate
issues.body:
Timeboxed to 2 h. Decide which radio KPIs each simulated cell emits and their realistic ranges.

### Questions to answer
- Which KPIs does an operator watch first (accessibility, retainability, throughput, latency, PRB utilisation, active UEs)?
- What are realistic normal ranges and daily (diurnal) patterns?
- What does a degraded cell look like for each fault type (outage, congestion, interference)?

### Output
- [ ] Wiki page `5G-KPI-Glossary` with the chosen KPIs, units and normal ranges
- [ ] Proto field list confirmed (feeds into the proto review issue)

issues.title: Review and agree the telemetry.proto API contract (ADR-0003)
issues.body:
The proto file is the contract between every component, so both of us must agree it before Sprint 1.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Partner reviews `proto/cellpulse/v1/telemetry.proto` and leaves at least one PR review comment or approval
- [ ] KPI fields match the KPI spike output
- [ ] ADR-0003 status changed from *Proposed* to *Accepted*

issues.title: Partner onboarding: run the project locally and open a first PR
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Clone the repo, run `make dev` and `make test`, and both pass
- [ ] Add yourself to `CONTRIBUTORS.md` in a PR that follows the PR template and the Conventional Commit title rule
- [ ] Post your first async stand-up in Discussions → Standups
- [ ] Note anything confusing in `CONTRIBUTING.md` as part of the same PR

issues.title: As an operator, I want an agent that simulates N cells' KPIs so that the system has realistic data
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `cellpulse-agent --site site-a --cells 10` produces one `CellKpi` per cell per second
- [ ] Values follow a diurnal curve plus noise, within the ranges in the KPI glossary
- [ ] Simulation is deterministic given `--seed` (needed for tests)
- [ ] Unit tests cover ranges and determinism

### Notes
Keep simulation separate from transport: `simulator.py` is pure logic, `client.py` is gRPC.

issues.title: As a platform engineer, I want a collector gRPC service that ingests streamed KPI batches
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Implements `TelemetryService.StreamKpis` (client-streaming) and `Health`
- [ ] Agent streams `KpiBatch` every 1 s; collector acks with count received
- [ ] Structured JSON logging with site, cell count and batch latency
- [ ] Integration test starts a collector in-process and streams 100 batches from a test agent
- [ ] Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM (drains in-flight streams)

issues.title: Containerise agent and collector; docker compose with 1 collector and 3 sites
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One multi-stage `Dockerfile`, non-root user, image < 200 MB
- [ ] `make up` brings up collector + agents `site-a`, `site-b`, `site-c`
- [ ] Container health checks on the collector
- [ ] Docker workflow publishes the image to GHCR on merge to main

issues.title: As a developer, I want `cellpulse-cli status` to show collector health and connected sites
issues.body:
Owned by partner. Self-contained: it only depends on the proto contract, so it never blocks the main path.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `cellpulse-cli status --target localhost:50051` prints the collector's version, uptime and connected sites as a table
- [ ] Exit code 1 with a clear message if the collector is unreachable
- [ ] Unit test with a fake gRPC server

### Hints
Use `argparse` (stdlib) and the generated stubs in `cellpulse.api`.

issues.title: As an operator, I want the collector to expose KPIs as Prometheus metrics
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `/metrics` on port 9100 exposes gauges `cellpulse_kpi{site,cell,kpi}`
- [ ] Self-metrics: `cellpulse_batches_total`, `cellpulse_ingest_latency_seconds` (histogram), `cellpulse_active_streams`
- [ ] Stale cells are removed from metrics after 60 s of silence
- [ ] Prometheus container scrapes both collectors

issues.title: As an operator, I want a Grafana 'RAN Overview' dashboard provisioned automatically
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Dashboard JSON committed in `deploy/grafana/dashboards/` and auto-provisioned
- [ ] Panels: throughput per site, PRB utilisation heatmap, drop rate top-10 cells, ingest latency p95, collector stream count
- [ ] Site and cell template variables
- [ ] Screenshot added to the README

issues.title: Scale out: 2 collectors with agents load-balanced across them
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `docker compose up --scale collector=2` works
- [ ] Agents use gRPC `round_robin` load balancing over DNS (`dns:///collector:50051`)
- [ ] Killing one collector makes its agents reconnect to the other within 5 s
- [ ] ADR written: why client-side load balancing instead of a proxy

issues.title: CI: docker compose smoke test
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Workflow job starts the stack, waits for health, and asserts Prometheus has `cellpulse_kpi` series from 3 sites
- [ ] Job is a required status check on `main`

issues.title: As a developer, I want `cellpulse-cli load` to generate K virtual cells and report throughput
issues.body:
Owned by partner; may run over into Sprint 3.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `cellpulse-cli load --cells 1000 --duration 60` streams synthetic batches using asyncio
- [ ] Prints msgs/s sent, acks received and p50/p95 round-trip latency
- [ ] `--json` flag for machine-readable output (used in the performance report)

issues.title: As a tester, I want fault injection in the simulator (outage, congestion, interference)
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `--fault cell-3:congestion@120s` style flag, or a schedule in a YAML file
- [ ] Each fault changes KPIs as described in the KPI glossary
- [ ] Ground-truth fault events are logged, so the detector can be scored

issues.title: As an operator, I want an anomaly detector that flags degraded cells automatically
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Service polls the Prometheus HTTP API every 10 s
- [ ] Per-cell rolling baseline (EWMA mean/variance) with a z-score threshold; documented in an ADR
- [ ] Exposes `cellpulse_anomaly{site,cell,kpi}` and logs an event per detection
- [ ] Precision/recall measured against injected faults and recorded in the wiki
- [ ] Stretch: compare with scikit-learn IsolationForest

issues.title: As an operator, I want no data loss when a collector restarts
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Agent buffers up to 60 s of batches in a bounded queue while disconnected
- [ ] Reconnect uses exponential backoff with jitter
- [ ] Integration test: kill the collector for 20 s; all buffered batches arrive after restart
- [ ] Metric `cellpulse_agent_buffer_depth`

issues.title: Prometheus alert rules for cell down and KPI degradation
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `deploy/prometheus/alerts.yml` with CellDown, HighDropRate and AnomalyDetected
- [ ] `promtool check rules` runs in CI

issues.title: Performance report: throughput and latency vs number of cells
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Run `cellpulse-cli load` at 100, 1k, 5k and 10k cells against 1 and 2 collectors
- [ ] Results table + chart on wiki page `Performance`, with hardware noted
- [ ] One paragraph on the bottleneck found and what would fix it

issues.title: README polish: demo GIF, architecture diagram, quickstart
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A recruiter understands the project in 30 seconds from the top of the README
- [ ] Demo GIF: compose up → dashboard → inject fault → anomaly flagged
- [ ] Badges: CI, CodeQL, release, licence
- [ ] Future work section

issues.title: Cut v1.0.0 release
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Merge the release-please PR to tag v1.0.0 with a generated changelog
- [ ] Image `ghcr.io/<owner>/distributed-telemetry:1.0.0` published

issues.title: Project retrospective report
issues.body:
### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Wiki page `Project-Report`: planned vs delivered points per sprint (velocity chart), what was cut and why, lessons learned working across time zones
- [ ] Links to all Sprint retro pages
- [ ] This becomes your interview story, so write it like one
